core_obligations: Prove case (1) via the derived diagonal lemma and the bootstrap lemma (proof lines 1851-1857).
Observe that cases (2) to (5) are special cases of (1) (proof line 1857).
Derive case (6) from the colimit compatibility (proof line 1858).
Derive cases (7) and (8) from the description of (strict) henselizations as filtered colimits of etale extensions (proof lines 1859-1862).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma listing nine situations in which the cotangent complex L_{B/A} vanishes: weakly etale maps, flat epimorphisms, localizations, unramified flat maps, etale maps, filtered colimits of vanishing maps, henselizations, strict henselizations, and an open placeholder item (source lines 1832-1849). The proof handles case (1) by applying the derived diagonal lemma to the surjective flat map B tensor_A B -> B to get L_{B/B tensor_A B} = 0 and then the bootstrap lemma; cases (2) to (5) are observed to be special cases of (1); case (6) is the colimit compatibility lemma; and cases (7) and (8) follow because (strict) henselizations are filtered colimits of etale ring extensions.
